description: This Java test file contains unit tests for the HasGlobalErrors matcher class, verifying its behavior in matching global errors within Spring's Errors object.

classes.name: HasGlobalErrorsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the HasGlobalErrors matcher functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test objects before each test execution.

methods.name: shouldAppendGlobalErrorsDescriptionIfCodeIsNull
methods.description: Tests description output when no specific error code is provided.

methods.name: shouldAppendGlobalErrorsDescriptionWithCodeIfCodeIsNonNull
methods.description: Tests description output when a specific error code is provided.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfCodeIsNullAndGivenErrorHasNoGlobalErrors
methods.description: Verifies that matcher does not match when error has no global errors and no code specified.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfCodeIsNullAndGivenErrorHasGlobalErrors
methods.description: Verifies that matcher successfully matches when there are global errors and no specific code is specified.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfCodeIsNonNullAndGivenErrorDoesNotHaveGlobalErrors
methods.description: Verifies that matcher does not match when a specific code is provided but errors do not contain it.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfCodeIsNonNullButNotContainedInGivenErrors
methods.description: Ensures matcher does not match if the specific code isn't in the errors list.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfCodeIsNonNullAndContainedInGivenErrors
methods.description: Checks that matcher matches when the specific error code is present in the errors.
